description: sdkmanager and avdmanager for installing Android SDK packages.

license.name: Android Software Development Kit License Agreement

notes: Official command-line tools ZIP from dl.google.com. Google publishes SHA1; the SHA256 was computed from the download after the SHA1 matched. You must accept the Android SDK licence before installing. ANDROID_HOME points at this install; add platforms with `sdkmanager --sdk_root=%ANDROID_HOME% "platforms;android-35"` — sdkmanager asks you to accept each package's licence itself (OpenMind never accepts licences for you).
